usedFor: Productive.io holds bookings, deals and invoices for an agency, and “New Booking” there can start Calendly's “Create Scheduling Link”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Booking” in Productive.io, then “Create Scheduling Link” in Calendly
bestTemplate.why: A fresh booking in Productive.io can pair with a link to schedule the matching meeting.

watchOut: “Updated Booking” and “Invoice Updated” fire on changes, so “Create Scheduling Link” can make a second link for one record.
